newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - LG&E Energy EPS lowered.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - LG&E Energy EPS lowered.

text.p: --Gruntal & Co Inc said Monday it lowered its EPS estimate on LG&E Energy Corp to $0.17 from $0.27 for the 1996 Q4 and to $1.49 from $1.59 for the full year.

--It said its action follows last week's disclosure by the company that its natural gas marketing unit discovered a "rogue" marketer in its Calgary office. The marketer made unauthorized and fraudulent transactions resulting in losses in the company's Canadian natural gas marketing business.
--Gruntal said it continues to consider LG&E to be a progressive comapny that should provide continued above-average growth. LG&E was at 24-1/4, off 1/8.
